entries.name: The Hub
entries.text: A quiet cave where every dive begins. The ring in the floor leads down, and the board on the wall keeps this journal.

entries.name: The Training Cave
entries.text: A short cave that teaches swimming, dashing and bombing. It ends in a ring that leads on to the Shallows.

entries.name: The Shallows
entries.text: The first biome: sunlit caves of tunnels, ledges and shafts. Find the ring at the bottom to swim deeper.

entries.name: The Shell Stall
entries.text: A keeper with three pedestals, tucked into a side cave. Swim onto an item to buy it with shells.

entries.name: Urchin
entries.text: A spiny ball that sits still on the rock. It never chases you, but touching it hurts.

entries.name: Piranha
entries.text: A fast fish that patrols and gives chase when it spots you. A dash straight through one is enough to beat it.

entries.name: Crab
entries.text: Scuttles along the rock, floor and ceiling alike. Keep your distance.

entries.name: Horned Growth
entries.text: Hard spikes that grow from the ceiling. They do not move, so swim around them.

entries.name: Manta
entries.text: A broad ray that glides through open water and spits at you. It needs wide caves.

entries.name: Cannon
entries.text: A fixed turret grown into the wall. It fires slow shots along its line of sight.

entries.name: The Beholder
entries.text: It comes for anyone who lingers too long in one level, and it does not stop.

entries.name: Current Jet
entries.text: A vent that blasts water along a line of bubbles. It does no harm, but it carries you where it points.

entries.name: Spike Wall
entries.text: A strip of hard spikes set into the rock face. Touching it hurts, so keep a body length away.

entries.name: Loose Rock
entries.text: A boulder wedged in a ledge that drops when you swim under it. Afterwards a bomb will clear it.

entries.name: Electric Eel
entries.text: It patrols a narrow shaft and glows just before a ring of shock spreads through open water. Rock stops it.

entries.name: Anemone Cluster
entries.text: Soft pink fronds that sway on the cave floor. They sting on contact, so swim over them, not through them.

entries.name: Plankton
entries.text: Glowing drifts of tiny life. Collect it for score.

entries.name: Shell
entries.text: A rare find, often tucked away on the cave floor. Worth a lot of score.

entries.name: Bomb
entries.text: Place one and swim clear: after a short fuse it breaks nearby rock and hurts anything close, you included.

entries.name: Heart
entries.text: Sold at the Shell Stall. Restores one heart, up to your maximum.

entries.name: Bomb Pack
entries.text: Sold at the Shell Stall. Three bombs in one bundle, up to the most you can carry.

entries.name: Flippers
entries.text: A pair of fins for the rest of the dive: you swim a fifth faster. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Lantern
entries.text: Widens the light around you so you see more of the dim cave ahead. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Shell Magnet
entries.text: Shells within three tiles slide towards you. Kept for the dive, lost if you fall.

entries.name: Bomb Bag
entries.text: Three bombs now, and room for one more in your stock. You can carry two. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Heart Container
entries.text: One more heart, and it heals one at once. You can carry two of these. Lost if you fall.

entries.name: Clam
entries.text: A sleeping clam with something shiny inside. A dash or a bomb cracks it open.

entries.name: Clay Pot
entries.text: An old pot on the cave floor. It shatters to a dash or a blast and hides a few shells.

entries.name: Chest
entries.text: Swim into a chest to open it for a pile of shells. Not every chest is honest.

entries.name: Hidden Pocket
entries.text: A rock tile with a hairline crack or a faint glint, hollow inside. Bomb it open.

entries.name: The Relic
entries.text: A golden idol worth twenty-five shells. Lift it and the ceiling starts to come down: keep moving.

entries.name: Marlo, the Stranded Diver
entries.text: Sealed in a pocket of rock with only his bubbles for company. Free him, find his lost tank, and he opens a shortcut.

entries.name: Pip, the Caged Critter
entries.text: A small friend shut in a cage in a side cave. Bring it to the exit and it moves into the hub.

entries.name: The Shopkeeper
entries.text: A hermit crab who sells whatever washes up, three things at a time. Shells only, and he flinches at bombs.

entries.name: The Sunken Wreck
entries.text: A ship that never made it home. Its hold still holds a chest and a few pots, and its mast leans over the seabed.

entries.name: The Urchin Garden
entries.text: A cave floor of low mounds where urchins grow in rows. Swim over them, never between them.

entries.name: The Jet Gauntlet
entries.text: A long tube of vents that blow along their lines of bubbles. Ride the currents or fight them.

entries.name: Cave Fish
entries.text: Harmless little fish that drift in schools through the open water. They never bite.

entries.name: Rune Carving
entries.text: Old marks cut into the rock face. Nobody remembers who made them, or why.

entries.name: Fossil
entries.text: A shell, a fish or a bone pressed into thick rock long before the water came.

entries.name: Wall Bush
entries.text: Stubborn little growths that cling to the cave wall.

entries.name: Cave Weed
entries.text: Tall glowing weed that sways on floors and ceilings. It hides nothing, but it makes the dark friendlier.

entries.name: Round Boulder
entries.text: A smooth old stone half sunk into the floor. It stays where it is, whatever you do.

entries.name: Quill, the Collector
entries.text: A fussy old octopus who trades in lost things. Bring him golden relics from the deep.
